title: S1-A classroom ref + Vanderbilt text

turns.text: Make ONE photorealistic still image, widescreen 16:9, no text on it. The attached picture is the ROOM; the scene must be exactly this room. Standing in its centre aisle, facing the camera, is this man: A light-skinned man around 60, with a long, broad oval face, high receding forehead, rounded chin, and prominent straight nose with a rounded tip. His thinning, wavy hair is swept back, darker on top and gray at the temples, with loose curls above the ears. Bushy gray sideburns extend down his cheeks to the jaw; his upper lip and chin are clean-shaven. Deep-set eyes, heavy brows, forehead creases, and crow’s-feet frame a closed-mouth, unsmiling expression. His head turns slightly toward the viewer’s left. He wears a mid-19th-century dark coat with broad lapels, a white shirt with a high standing collar, and a wide dark cravat tied in a large bow with hanging ends. He is the only person. Daylight from the windows.

must_haves: The room is the classroom in the attached photo.
The man matches the description (age ~60, receding swept-back hair, grey sideburns, clean-shaven lip and chin, dark 19th-century coat, white standing collar, wide dark cravat).
